notes.title: 🌸 It’s Time to Bloom! Cozy Gardener Simulator is OUT NOW in Early Access!
notes.content:
[p][b]Cozy Gardener Simulator[/b] is officially live on Steam in Early Access![/p][p]Tend to your own peaceful garden, help neighbors, and bring joy back to your town one small task at a time. Whether you're planting veggies, sweeping leaves, or unlocking secret garden spots, every action brings a little more life to this cozy little world.[/p][p]🌼 [b]Grow your paradise, your way[/b] – no deadlines, no stress.
🌿 [b]Help your town bloom[/b] – take on tasks, decorate public spaces, and unlock new areas.
🛠️ [b]Customize and collect[/b] – new tools, seeds, and charming decorations await![/p][p]🎥 Join us on launch day for a special gameplay livestream where the devs share tips and their favorite cozy moments.[/p][p]🛒 [b]Play now[/b] and help shape the future of Cozy Gardener Simulator![/p]
